messages:
Priya: Heads-up, after the canary cutover ~10:45 UTC the latency dashboard lost the p95/p99 lines for most prod services. Panels show p50 only. Anyone see this in their dashboards?
Jordan: saw that too, noticed when I switched time range the percentile series are just not there. p50 and avg still ok.
Lee: ops-bot posted deploy success around the same time? Could be transform in the metrics pipeline.
ops-bot: deploy: canary->prod cutover complete (release/telemetry-v3). triggered at 2026-03-17T10:45:12Z :rocket:
Sam: quick check: dashboard panels query summary metrics (redwood_request_duration_seconds{quantile=~"0.95|0.99"}) — those series are absent from Prom.
Priya: interesting, the runtime metrics team rolled a metric-renaming/transformer change in telemetry-v3. Could that have removed label-based quantile series?
Jordan: yep, the transformer now converts summaries to histograms at ingest for storage savings, but the conversion path strips the "quantile" label. Dashboards still expect summary-style quantile labels.
Lee: repro: run this PromQL on prod: `sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_sum[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_count[5m]))` returns avg but `redwood_request_duration_seconds{quantile="0.95"}` returns 0 series.
Sam: workaround: change panels to use `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, service))` — that'll restore p95/p99 lines until we fix the transformer.
Priya: ETA on a hotfix? We can either revert the transform or patch it to emit synthetic quantile labels when a summary->histogram conversion occurs.
Jordan: short-term I can flip the ingest config to leave summaries untouched for the prod cluster. That requires a reload of the metrics-transformer config. Plan: patch config and post-reload verification.
Lee: steps I used to verify locally: 1) query buckets via `sum(rate(..._bucket[5m])) by (le, service)` 2) run `histogram_quantile` in grafana explore 3) confirm series with p95/p99 present.
Sam: I'm going to open a changelog entry and add dashboard remediation notes. Also adding runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/observability/summary-histogram-compat (internal).
Priya: thanks. Jordan — please do the config toggle and call when done. If rollback needed we'll coordinate a brief rollback of telemetry-v3.
Jordan: toggling now, will post when reload completes.
ops-bot: config reload triggered for namespace telemetry (metrics-transformer-configmap).
Jordan: reload done. dashboards back to showing p95/p99 after forcing a panel refresh. Can folks confirm?
Lee: confirmed on my end for payments and proxy services. p95/p99 lines returned. :thumbsup:
Sam: added ticket INF-3249 to track longer-term fix (emit synthetic quantile labels or adapt dashboards). Assigning to telemetry team.
Priya: great — leave the short-term toggle in place until we ship the proper compatibility patch. Thanks everyone.
